visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Intro: A hand holds a packaged pink arm band in front of a retail shelf filled with similar products. Large green and pink text boxes overlay the center of the frame. (2) Product 1: The camera focuses on the "Water Absorption Arm Band" packaging. The hand moves the product slightly to show the details. (3) Product 2: A beige round bowl-like makeup brush cleaner is picked up from a shelf. The hand turns it over to reveal specialized textures on the inner bottom for cleaning and a circular grid on the outer bottom for drying. (4) Product 3: A gray rolled-up fabric pouch is unrolled to reveal multiple mesh zippered compartments. The hand demonstrates that one of the mesh bags can be detached from the main pouch via a velcro strip. (5) Outro: A wide shot shows the brightly lit entrance of a '3COINS+plus' retail store within a shopping mall. The final frame transition to a pink informational screen with various social media icons and website links.
